 Nykaa Taps Experiential Retail to Drive Beauty Discovery Through Nykaaland 4.0 
 BY - Indian Retailer Bureau 
 Sub Editor
 Oct 28, 2026 
 Oct 28, 2026 / 
 127 
 / 7 MIN READ 
 Follow Us 
 -->
 -->
 Nykaa’s conducted a three day event, Nykaaland, between October 23 to 25 attracting over 30,000 attendees, highlighting the growing role of experiential retail, product discovery and community engagement in India’s beauty market.
 The festival was co-produced by Nykaa and BookMyShow Live, the live entertainment and experiential division of BookMyShow. The fourth edition brought together more than 65 Indian and international beauty brands, beauty experts, creators and consumers through product showcases, masterclasses, shopping experiences and live entertainment.
 The event reflects how beauty brands are increasingly looking beyond conventional retail channels to engage consumers through immersive experiences that encourage product trials, education and direct interaction.
 Experiential Formats Drive Consumer Engagement 
 For beauty companies, such platforms offer opportunities to introduce new products, engage potential customers and build stronger connections with consumers beyond traditional advertising and online shopping.
 “With its fourth edition, Nykaaland continues to redefine immersive beauty experiences in India, welcoming over 30,000 attendees. Each year, the festival grows in scale and ambition, with new partners, stronger collaborations with the likes of Starbucks and YouTube, our biggest-ever Korean beauty curation, and the presence of global beauty brands such as Rare Beauty and Huda Beauty,” said Anchit Nayar, Executive Director and CEO, Nykaa Beauty.
 He added that consumer participation reflected growing demand for experiences that combine product discovery, expertise and community.
 Global Beauty Brands and K-Beauty Take Centre Stage 
 Nykaaland 4.0 featured international brands such as Rare Beauty, Huda Beauty, Kayali and ISDIN, alongside Indian brands including Kay Beauty and Nykaa Cosmetics.
 The festival also hosted its biggest Korean beauty curation to date, featuring brands such as Laneige, Beauty of Joseon and TONYMOLY. The dedicated K-beauty zone provided a platform for consumers to explore Korean skincare and beauty products in one place.
 The expanded brand mix brought premium international labels and homegrown players together, offering brands an opportunity to connect with beauty enthusiasts through product demonstrations, discovery-led experiences and direct consumer engagement.
 Partnerships also extended beyond beauty. The Nykaaland x Starbucks collaboration and YouTube’s association brought food, content and culture into the festival experience, while exclusive shopping offers and live entertainment added to the consumer proposition.
 Masterclasses, Creators and Live Entertainment Expand the Format 
 The three-day programme combined professional beauty education with music and entertainment. Celebrity makeup artists and industry experts, including Namrata Soni, Daniel Bauer, Reva Goswami, Guneet Virdi and Komal Gulati, conducted sessions covering makeup and beauty techniques.
 The festival’s entertainment programme featured performances by Girls Girls Girls, Kelcy Starr, Bombay Rockers, Gurnazar and Sukhbir, among others. The Nykaa Play Show added comedy and creator-led programming, with appearances by Gaurav Kapoor, Ruhee Dosani and Karan Wahi.
 Brand-led celebrity activations further strengthened the festival’s reach. Swiss Beauty featured Taapsee Pannu, while Mamonde brought Nitanshi Goel to the event. Dot & Key hosted Shanaya Kapoor, Aditya Roy Kapur, Varun Sood and Apoorva Makhija, while Chicnutrix collaborated with Mallika Dua.
 Nykaa also brought creators Rida Tharana, Sakshi Sindhwani, Tarini Peshawaria and Ashi Khanna to the festival, connecting the brand ecosystem with established online beauty communities.
 Nykaaland Positions Experiential Marketing as a Growth Avenue 
 For Nykaa and its brand partners, Nykaaland offers a platform to bring together product discovery, consumer engagement and entertainment within a single format. By combining brand showcases with expert sessions, celebrity appearances and live performances, the festival seeks to extend beauty engagement beyond product transactions.
 Naman Pugalia, Chief Business Officer – Live Events, BookMyShow, said the event demonstrated how experiential intellectual properties can bring beauty, culture and entertainment together to create a more immersive consumer journey.
 He added that the focus was on building meaningful consumer connections through curated experiences that extend beyond brand discovery and encourage deeper audience engagement.
 As beauty brands compete for consumer attention across digital platforms, marketplaces and physical stores, experiential formats such as Nykaaland provide another channel for sampling, education and community-building.
 The fourth edition’s attendance and extended visitor engagement highlight the potential of such events to create destinations where consumers can explore multiple brands in one setting. For the wider beauty industry, the model also presents opportunities to introduce emerging categories, strengthen brand visibility and engage consumers through experiences that complement conventional retail.

 Humuss Beauty Expands Skincare Portfolio with Barrier-Focused ‘Barrier Boost’ Cleanser 
 BY - Indian Retailer Bureau 
 Sub Editor 
 Oct 01, 2026 
 / 1 MIN READ 
 Follow Us 
 Humuss Beauty, a vegan and cruelty-free skincare brand, has expanded its product portfolio with the launch of ‘Barrier Boost’ Gentle Face Cleanser , a daily gel-based cleanser designed to cleanse, refresh and brighten the skin while avoiding a dry or stripped after-feel. 
 The launch comes as skincare consumers increasingly seek products that combine everyday efficacy with gentler formulations and barrier-conscious benefits. Humuss Beauty has positioned the new cleanser around this intersection, combining cleansing, mild exfoliation and radiance-focused ingredients in a single daily-use product. 
 Technology-led formulation 
 At the centre of Barrier Boost is the brand’s patented Pumpkin Seed Stem Cell Technology , combined with Gatuline® Radiance , a cosmetic active developed by Gattefossé. According to the brand, the combination is designed to support a fresher, smoother and more radiant-looking complexion while complementing the cleanser’s gentle cleansing action. 
 The formulation also incorporates Vitamin E Active Beads, Glycolic Acid, Papaya Extract and Aloe Vera Extract . Glycolic Acid and Papaya Extract are intended to help remove dead skin cells and refine the appearance of pores, while Vitamin E and Aloe Vera help condition the skin and maintain a comfortable after-feel. 
 The product reflects Humuss Beauty’s positioning around accessible skincare that focuses on maintaining the skin barrier while delivering visible skincare benefits. 
 Rethinking the daily cleanser 
 Commenting on the launch, Prabal Bhatia, Co-Founder, Humuss Beauty , said, “With Barrier Boost, we wanted to rethink the role of a daily cleanser. Cleansing should not leave the skin feeling tight or stripped; it should be the first step towards healthier-looking, more balanced skin. By combining carefully selected brightening, exfoliating and antioxidant ingredients with advanced skincare technology, we have created a cleanser that brings together everyday cleansing and barrier-conscious skincare.” 
 Designed for everyday skincare routines 
 Barrier Boost Gentle Face Cleanser is SLS-free and paraben-free and is positioned by the brand as suitable for all skin types. The formula is designed to cleanse without stripping the skin while supporting a fresh and radiant-looking complexion. 
 For use, consumers can pump a small quantity onto damp hands, lather and gently massage it onto a wet face in circular motions before rinsing thoroughly. Humuss Beauty recommends using the cleanser twice daily as part of a regular skincare routine. 
 Online-first availability 
 The cleanser is currently available through Humuss Beauty’s official website and Flipkart , priced at Rs 499 . The brand plans to expand availability to additional online platforms, including Amazon and Smytten . 
 The multi-platform rollout will give the brand access to a wider online consumer base as it builds distribution for its skincare portfolio. 
 Building an accessible skincare proposition 
 Humuss Beauty describes itself as a vegan and sustainable skincare brand focused on clean and barrier-supportive formulations. Its portfolio strategy centres on combining efficacy-driven ingredients with responsible beauty practices and developing everyday skincare products and targeted treatments for diverse Indian skin needs. 
 With Barrier Boost, the brand is expanding its proposition into the daily cleansing segment while bringing together cleansing, mild exfoliation and radiance-focused skincare in a single product.

 Swiss Beauty Select Marks Second Anniversary, Eyes 100+ Kiosks in Two Years 
 BY - Indian Retailer Bureau 
 Sub Editor 
 Sep 29, 2026 
 / 1 MIN READ 
 Follow Us 
 Swiss Beauty Select, the premium makeup range from Swiss Beauty, has completed two years in the market, expanding its retail footprint across metros and non-metros while strengthening its presence across modern trade, e-commerce and quick commerce channels.
 Launched in 2024 to mark Swiss Beauty’s 11th anniversary, Select was introduced as a premium beauty proposition combining makeup with skincare-led benefits and performance-focused formulations across face, eyes and lips.
 As it enters its third year, the brand is focusing on distribution expansion, product innovation and premiumisation, with offline channels currently contributing around 65 per cent of its business, while online channels account for the remaining 35 per cent.
 Expands Offline Retail Presence 
 Swiss Beauty Select has expanded its offline presence through larger-format stores, including its recent outlet at Phoenix United, Bareilly, and its first larger-format store at Lulu Mall, Hyderabad.
 The brand also has a presence across premium General Trade Beauty Advisors’ outlets and 300+ Modern Trade doors, including retailers such as Shoppers Stop and Lifestyle.
 Kiosks are emerging as another growth channel for the brand. Select currently operates 40+ kiosks and plans to take this network to more than 100 outlets over the next two years, across both metro and non-metro markets.
 Quick Commerce Emerges as Growth Channel 
 While offline retail remains the larger contributor to Select’s business, digital channels are gaining importance, with quick commerce emerging as the fastest-growing online channel.
 The brand is currently available through Swiss Beauty’s D2C platform, leading e-commerce marketplaces, Swiss Beauty Exclusive Brand Outlets, and select Modern Trade and General Trade Beauty Advisors’ outlets.
 According to Mohit Goyal, Director and Co-Founder, Swiss Beauty, the brand was created to respond to changing consumer expectations around makeup.
 “The idea behind Select has been to approach makeup differently. Its portfolio combines colour cosmetics with skincare-led benefits, reflecting the way beauty consumers are increasingly choosing products today.”
 He added that consumers are becoming more discerning about their makeup choices, with Select focusing on “high-performance, hardworking, skin-infused formulations” designed for everyday beauty routines.
 Premium Makeup at Accessible Price Points 
 Select’s portfolio includes products such as High On Glow Fixer, High On Shine Lipstick and the 12 Eyeshadow Palette, along with newer launches including Born To Bloom Blush + Highlighter, Born To Dazzle Glitter Spray and High On Moisture Primer.
 With products starting at approximately Rs 399, the brand is positioned as an accessible entry point into premium makeup. Its proposition combines premium packaging and performance-oriented formulations with price points aimed at consumers looking to trade up within beauty.
 International Expansion 
 Swiss Beauty Select has also begun its international expansion with an entry into the UAE.
 The range is currently available in the market through platforms including Noon and Amazon, marking the first step in the brand’s international growth plans.
 ‘#SelectWhatsYours’ Marks Second Anniversary 
 To mark its second anniversary, Swiss Beauty Select has launched the #SelectWhatsYours campaign, centred on individual beauty choices and personal expression.
 The campaign focuses on the idea that beauty is not necessarily about following every trend, but about identifying products and styles that align with individual preferences.
 As Select enters its third year, the brand is looking to build on its hybrid beauty proposition through continued product launches, wider distribution and deeper penetration across premium beauty retail.
 With the premiumisation trend gaining momentum in India's beauty market, Select’s strategy combines accessible premium pricing, offline retail expansion, digital commerce and product innovation as it seeks to strengthen its position in the premium makeup segment.

 Nykaa, L’Oréal’s BOLD Join Hands to Invest in High-Growth Indian Beauty Brands 
 BY - Indian Retailer Bureau 
 Sub Editor 
 Sep 24, 2026 
 / 1 MIN READ 
 Follow Us 
 India’s beauty and personal care market is witnessing growing interest from global beauty companies and strategic investors as homegrown brands scale across digital and physical channels. In the latest development, Nykaa and BOLD (Business Opportunities for L’Oréal Development) have announced a collaboration to jointly invest in emerging Indian beauty and wellness brands. 
 Under the partnership, BOLD and Nykaa will take minority stakes in brands that demonstrate strong consumer traction and differentiated propositions. The investments will remain purely financial, allowing founders to retain ownership and operational control of their businesses. 
 The partnership will also give selected brands access to the respective ecosystems of both companies. While BOLD will bring L’Oréal’s global beauty expertise, mentorship and international network , Nykaa will contribute its omnichannel retail infrastructure, distribution capabilities and understanding of Indian beauty consumers. 
 Focus on Scaling Homegrown Beauty Brands 
 The collaboration comes as India's beauty ecosystem sees the emergence of a growing number of homegrown, digitally native and specialised brands across skincare, haircare, colour cosmetics, wellness and other personal care categories. 
 For emerging brands, access to capital is increasingly being accompanied by the need for distribution, retail visibility, consumer insights and category expertise. The Nykaa-BOLD partnership is positioned to address these requirements by combining investment with operational guidance. 
 The companies said the objective is to help Indian beauty founders scale faster and build enduring brands for both India and international markets , while allowing founders to retain their individual brand identity, teams and creative direction. 
 L’Oréal Deepens Its India Startup Focus 
 For L’Oréal, the partnership expands the role of BOLD , its corporate venture capital arm launched in 2018. 
 BOLD invests across the beauty value chain through minority investments in innovative and high-growth startups. Its investment focus spans two broad areas, Beauty and Wellness Brands, and Science and Technology for Beauty. 
 Beyond capital, BOLD provides portfolio companies with access to L’Oréal's beauty expertise, global network and mentoring capabilities while maintaining the independence of the businesses it backs. 
 Jacques Lebel, Managing Director, L’Oréal India, said the partnership is aimed at supporting Indian entrepreneurs with capital and expertise while allowing founders to build their brands independently. 
 Nykaa Brings Omnichannel Retail Advantage 
 For Nykaa, the collaboration strengthens its position within India's expanding beauty startup ecosystem beyond its role as a retailer. 
 The company's established digital platform, physical retail network and consumer ecosystem provide emerging brands with potential access to multiple consumer touchpoints. The partnership could also help selected brands navigate the transition from digital-first operations to broader omnichannel distribution. 
 Anchit Nayar, Executive Director and CEO, Nykaa Beauty, said the partnership will combine Nykaa's consumer ecosystem, retail network and distribution capabilities with L'Oréal's global beauty expertise. 
 What It Means for India's Beauty Market 
 The collaboration reflects a broader shift in India's beauty industry, where capital, retail access and brand-building expertise are increasingly becoming interconnected growth drivers . 
 For emerging beauty brands, funding can help support product development and expansion, while access to established retail and distribution networks can accelerate consumer reach. Strategic partnerships with large beauty players can also provide founders with category knowledge and international exposure without requiring them to surrender operational control. 
 As India's beauty market continues to attract homegrown entrepreneurs, D2C brands and global players, partnerships such as Nykaa and BOLD's could create another route for emerging brands to access both capital and scale while retaining their entrepreneurial independence.

 Dario Vitale Appointed Creative Director of Emporio Armani and Giorgio Armani Accessories 
 BY - Indian Retailer Bureau 
 Sub Editor 
 Sep 17, 2026 
 / 1 MIN READ 
 Follow Us 
 The Armani Group has appointed Dario Vitale as Creative Director of Emporio Armani and Giorgio Armani Accessories, marking a new phase in the luxury fashion house’s creative leadership.
 Vitale is the first person outside the Armani family to take on the role. He brings extensive experience in the fashion industry, with a career spanning leading international fashion companies and a focus on product, quality, consistency and contemporary design.
 In his new role, Vitale will oversee the creative direction of Emporio Armani and Giorgio Armani Accessories, with the appointment aimed at supporting the evolution of both businesses while maintaining the design identity associated with the Armani name.
 “I am honored to take on this dual role across Emporio Armani, and deeply grateful to Silvana and Leo for welcoming me into their world,” Vitale said. He added that Armani’s legacy and distinctive design language provide a strong foundation for building what he described as a “new era” for the brands.
 Silvana Armani, Head of Womenswear Design, and Leo Dell’Orco, Head of Menswear Design at the Armani Group, said Vitale’s international experience would help interpret Emporio Armani’s spirit while remaining aligned with its identity.
 The Group also highlighted the strategic importance of Emporio Armani and the growth opportunity for Giorgio Armani Accessories. Giuseppe Marsocci, CEO and Managing Director of the Armani Group, said the appointment strengthens the company’s creative organisation while supporting its evolution and maintaining Giorgio Armani’s values and vision.

 Vaseline Goes “Bassline”: How a Creator-Led Trend Became a Brand Moment 
 BY - Indian Retailer Bureau 
 Sub Editor 
 Aug 28, 2026 
 / 1 MIN READ 
 Follow Us 
 What started as a Korean skincare creator’s playful pronunciation of Vaseline has evolved into a viral internet moment, with creators and social media users turning “Bassline” into memes, remixes and their own interpretations across platforms.
 From a Vaseline Collection to a Viral “Bassline” Moment 
 The trend began when Korean skincare creator Min Day Lee showcased her extensive Vaseline collection and enthusiastically referred to it as “Baseline”, which quickly became “Bassline” across social media. The pronunciation added to the charm of the moment, as the Korean language adapts the English “V” sound to a sound closer to its local equivalent.
 What followed was a wave of internet culture around the moment, with users recreating the original format while adding their own creative interpretations. The trend soon travelled beyond skincare communities, finding its way onto Indian social feeds and becoming part of everyday internet conversations.
 Instead of simply watching the trend unfold, Vaseline chose to join the conversation. The brand leaned into the moment across its social media, echoing the viral pronunciation with captions such as “BASELINEEEEEEE” and embracing the community-driven humour around the trend.
Speaking about the trend, Pratik Ved, VP Skincare, Hindustan Unilever said, “We didn't create this moment; the internet did. Our job was to simply show up. “Basseline” is proof that when a brand is genuinely loved, people will remix it in ways no brief could ever imagine, and all we can do is thank them for it." The internet decides. The icons get verified.
 Taking the viral social hijack a step further, Vaseline has officially validated the consumer-led movement by honoring key creators, including Min Day Lee, as certified ‘Vaseline-Verified Hijack Icons’.
 The brand is also inviting its wider community to become part of the movement by creating their own “Bassline” interpretations. Consumers can tag @vaselineindia and use #VaselineHijacked for a chance to be recognised as an official ‘Vaseline Verified Hijack Icon’.
 With the campaign, Vaseline is turning what began as an organic creator moment into a larger community-driven movement, demonstrating how brands can participate in internet culture by listening to their audiences, embracing humour and allowing consumers to shape the conversation.

 Swiss Beauty and Warner Bros. Discovery Join Forces, launches Harry Potter-Inspired Beauty Collection 
 BY - Indian Retailer Bureau 
 Sub Editor 
 Aug 27, 2026 
 / 1 MIN READ 
 Follow Us 
 Swiss Beauty, one of India's fastest-growing beauty brands, today announced the launch of its limited-edition Harry Potter-inspired makeup collection in collaboration with Warner Bros. Discovery Global Consumer Products (WBDGCP), bringing one of the world's most beloved entertainment franchises into the world of beauty through a spellbinding, collectible experience inspired by the wizarding world of Harry Potter.
 Curated around Swiss Beauty's philosophy of creating trend-forward products that align with evolving consumer aspirations, the Harry Potter-inspired collection celebrates imagination and self-expression through thoughtfully crafted beauty essentials. Designed for beauty enthusiasts, Harry Potter fans, and collectors alike, the range brings together iconic wizarding-inspired elements, premium formulations, and distinctive packaging to create beauty keepsakes that celebrate the nostalgia and legacy of one of the world's most beloved franchises.
 Inspired by the iconic wizarding world, the collection reimagines beloved spells, Hogwarts house identities, and instantly recognisable symbols through a beauty-first lens. Every product has been thoughtfully crafted with collectible packaging, innovative textures, and multidimensional finishes that capture the nostalgia and wonder of the Harry Potter universe while inspiring creative makeup expression. Reflecting Swiss Beauty's continued emphasis on delivering globally inspired beauty experiences, the collection seamlessly blends artistry, fandom, and innovation for consumers seeking beauty that is both expressive and collectible.
 Commenting on the launch, Vikram Sharma, SVP and Head of APAC Consumer Products at Warner Bros. Discovery, said, "India is one of our key growth markets, and beauty represents a significant opportunity to engage new consumers through licensing. Harry Potter continues to resonate with generations of fans across the country, making it a powerful platform for brands looking to create meaningful consumer connections. Our collaboration with Swiss Beauty brings together the joy of makeup with the enduring appeal of the wizarding world, creating a collection that fans can connect with through every design detail and collectible element while helping the brand reach new audiences in an authentic and engaging way."
 Mohit Goyal, Co-Founder & Director, Swiss Beauty, added, "Innovation has always been at the heart of Swiss Beauty's journey. The Harry Potter-inspired collection reflects our commitment to bringing culturally relevant collaborations to our consumers while continuing to push the boundaries of beauty innovation. By combining high-performance formulations with imaginative storytelling, we hope to create products that spark curiosity, confidence, and joy for beauty lovers across the country."
 Shalini Kochar, AVP Marketing, Swiss Beauty, said, "Today's beauty consumer is looking for products that offer more than functionality, they want experiences, stories, and a sense of connection with the brands they choose. Our collaboration with Warner Bros. Discovery Consumer Products for the beloved Harry Potter franchise allows us to tap into this shift in a meaningful way by bringing together beauty, fandom, and nostalgia. Through this collection, we aim to create a highly engaging consumer experience that extends beyond the product and encourages discovery, conversation, and self-expression. It is a reflection of Swiss Beauty's approach to building culturally relevant brand experiences that resonate with the next generation of beauty consumers."
 Product Details 
 Spellbinding Tinted Gloss 
 Inspired by the enchanting world of spells, the Spellbinding Tinted Gloss delivers luminous shine with a comfortable, non-sticky finish. Available in three captivating shades, Incendio Cherry Red, Bombarda Toffee Brown, and Confringo Berry Pink, each gloss offers a rich wash of colour while leaving lips looking smooth, plush, and effortlessly radiant.
 Transfiguration-Inspired Colour-Changing Foundation 
 Where wonder meets innovation, the Transfiguration-inspired Colour-Changing Foundation features a striking white formula that adapts to individual skin tones upon application. Lightweight and blendable, the foundation transforms smoothly into a natural-looking complexion, offering a personalised finish that celebrates every skin tone.
 Classy Multichrome Eyeliner 
 Designed to create striking eye looks with minimal effort, the Classy Multichrome Eyeliner features four mesmerising shades that shift beautifully under changing light. Its fluid texture and multidimensional finish add drama, making every swipe a statement.
 Makeup Brush Set Inspired by Patronus Charms 
 Inspired by the Patronus charm, this Makeup Brush Set transforms everyday application into an enhanced beauty ritual. Designed for precision and effortless blending, the beautifully designed brushes combine functionality with collectible appeal, making them a standout addition to every makeup enthusiast's vanity.
 Eyeshadow Designed to Celebrate House Pride 
 Celebrating the individuality and spirit of the iconic Hogwarts Houses, the eyeshadow palette range features four multichrome shades that deliver stunning colour payoff with dynamic, light-reflecting pigments. Designed for versatile looks, the eyeshadows create dimension and brilliance with every application.

 While the monsoon season brings cooler temperatures, increased humidity can create conditions that make a baby’s delicate skin more vulnerable to irritation. Excessive sweating, prolonged dampness and friction from clothing can weaken the skin’s natural protective barrier, often resulting in dryness, discomfort and irritation. This makes gentle yet effective cleansing an important part of everyday baby care, particularly during the monsoon season.
 Many parents may not realise that a baby’s skin has different needs from adult skin. One common mistake is using regular adult soaps or cleansers that are not specifically formulated for a baby’s delicate skin. While these products may effectively remove dirt and impurities, they can also strip the skin of its natural moisture and disrupt its protective barrier, leaving it dry and more susceptible to irritation and discomfort. Choosing cleansing products or soaps specifically designed for babies can help maintain skin comfort, hydration and overall skin health from the very first days of life.
 Reinforcing its commitment to protecting babies’ skin from Day 1, Johnson’s Baby Soap with Triple Protection is designed to provide the trusted benefits parents seek during seasonal changes, gentle protection against dryness, irritation and germs. Clinically proven mild for newborn skin and dermatologist-tested, the soap gently removes sweat, dirt and impurities while helping preserve the skin’s natural moisture balance, making it suitable for everyday use from birth.
 Commenting on the importance of choosing the right cleansing solutions as part of a baby’s skincare routine, Dr. Dilip Tripathi, Global Research & Development Head, Baby Health, Kenvue, said, “A baby’s skin is naturally thinner and more delicate than adult skin, making it especially vulnerable during the monsoon when humidity, sweat and friction can challenge the skin’s protective barrier. This makes gentle cleansing especially important, not just for hygiene but also for maintaining healthy skin. Johnson’s Baby Soap is specifically formulated for newborn skin, is clinically proven mild and dermatologist-tested, and cleanses effectively without compromising the skin’s natural moisture barrier. Establishing a consistent skincare routine with products designed specifically for babies can help support skin comfort and protection throughout changing seasons.”
 As parents increasingly seek science-backed and dermatologist-tested skincare solutions for their children, experts continue to emphasise the importance of maintaining a consistent skincare routine. Gentle cleansing with products specifically formulated for babies, keeping the skin clean and dry, and protecting its natural barrier can help support healthy-looking skin throughout the monsoon season and beyond.

 Follow Us 
 Fashion designer Sabyasachi Mukherjee has unveiled a new 26,000 sq. ft. flagship store at The Citadel in Mehrauli, New Delhi, marking another significant step in the luxury brand’s retail expansion. The new store doubles the footprint of the brand’s earlier two-building location in the same area and introduces dedicated spaces for high jewellery and accessories.
 The launch represents the latest chapter in a retail strategy that Sabyasachi has been developing for nearly two decades. At a time when Indian luxury fashion was largely represented through compact boutiques and multi-brand stores, the designer pioneered the concept of large-format standalone retail spaces designed to provide consumers with a complete and immersive expression of the brand.
 “I have never believed that a luxury store should simply sell products. It should inspire curiosity, preserve culture and create memory. Commerce may bring people through the door, but culture is what makes the return. As the world becomes increasingly digital, spaces that celebrate craftsmanship, beauty and human connection become more valuable than ever,” said Sabyasachi Mukherjee, Founder and Creative Director, Sabyasachi.
 A Retail Space Rooted in Kolkata 
 The new flagship reflects Mukherjee’s enduring connection with Kolkata, drawing inspiration from some of the city’s most recognisable landmarks, including Chowringhee and Hogg’s Market.
 Rather than functioning purely as a retail outlet, the space brings together the brand’s couture and jewellery collections with an extensive assortment of antiques, heritage textiles, artworks, vintage objects and Indian curiosities.
 The store has been conceived as an immersive cultural environment, with its design inspired by the romance and nostalgia of luxury train travel. Labyrinthine corridors lead visitors through a carefully curated collection of objects and artworks, creating a sense of discovery throughout the space.
 The interiors feature 120 chandeliers, nearly 200 antique carpets, 300 original paintings from the Sabyasachi Art Foundation, and more than 100 antique textiles, mirrors and decorative objects.
 From Luxury Store to Cultural Destination 
 Materiality and craftsmanship form a central part of the store's design. Lavish mother-of-pearl inlay, pink Sarrancolin marble and life-sized statues add to the theatricality of the interiors, while a bespoke installation inspired by the tramcars of Calcutta further reinforces the brand's connection to Indian cultural heritage.
 The experience extends beyond visual design. An immersive playlist curated by Sabyasachi Mukherjee and Bengali tea rituals have been incorporated into the space, creating an environment intended to engage visitors through multiple senses.
 With its expanded footprint, dedicated jewellery and accessories spaces, and museum-like interiors, the new Mehrauli flagship reflects Sabyasachi's broader approach to luxury retail, one where fashion, jewellery, art, architecture and cultural storytelling coexist under one roof.
 The new store therefore serves not only as a larger retail destination for the brand but also as an expression of its evolving vision for luxury, creating physical spaces that encourage discovery, celebrate Indian craftsmanship and heritage, and offer consumers an experience that extends beyond the products themselves.
